name: Cash Balance 13
definition: Balance details for a cash account.

Amount.name: Amount
Amount.definition: Currency and amount of money of the cash balance.

CreditDebitIndicator.name: Credit Debit Indicator
CreditDebitIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the balance is a credit or a debit balance. A zero balance is considered to be a credit balance.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Specifies the nature of a balance.

Status.name: Status
Status.definition: Current status of a cash balance.

ValueDate.name: Value Date
ValueDate.definition: Date and time at which the balance is or will be available.

ProcessingDate.name: Processing Date
ProcessingDate.definition: Date or date time when the balance was last updated following an entry posted to the account, in the books of the account servicing institution.

NumberOfPayments.name: Number Of Payments
NumberOfPayments.definition: Number of payments taken into account for the calculation of the cash balance value.

RestrictionType.name: Restriction Type
RestrictionType.definition: Type providing further information on balance restrictions.
